scientific_role: freeze the precipitation source and transformation before any Snapshot USA sequence response row is opened

product.dataset: Daymet: Daily Surface Weather Data on a 1-km Grid for North America, Version 4 R1

single_pixel_tool.coordinate_crs: WGS84 decimal degrees supplied by Snapshot USA deployments

eligibility.selection_source: frozen Snapshot USA deployment-metadata site selection

raw_cache_contract.canonical_query_coordinate_format: decimal degrees with 8 digits after decimal point
raw_cache_contract.daymet_leap_calendar_note: Daymet keeps leap day and omits Dec 31 in leap years; Snapshot USA response timestamps end Dec 19, so every required response date is covered

temporal_transformation.context_week: ISO calendar week from Snapshot Start_Time
temporal_transformation.precipitation_context_value: sum Daymet daily prcp over all seven Monday-Sunday dates in the ISO week
temporal_transformation.hour_dependence: none; the same weekly precipitation value is repeated across the four six-hour bins within site-week

standardization.fit_population: training contexts with strictly positive reconstructed observation effort in at least one frozen training stream
standardization.mean: arithmetic mean over unique spatial_unit x ISO-week training contexts
standardization.sd: population standard deviation over the same unique training contexts
